Bugtopia is Participating in the Wholesome Games Celebration with 20% off!

300+ lifelike bugs to collect and grow—breed them to unlock rare species! Customize your terrarium with 300+ landscaping items and 70+ backgrounds. A tiny, soothing nature escape on your screen!🦋🐌🦗🐝🐞🐛🦐 Let's spend a joyful summer time with little bug friends!

The [b]Wholesome Games Celebration[/b] on Steam invites players from around the world to experience a carefully curated selection of games that inspire hope, joy, and introspection. Running from August 7-14, the event will feature an exciting lineup of world premiere game announcements, new releases, discounts, and new demos.

[b]ABOUT THE WHOLESOME GAMES CELEBRATION[/b] 
Now in its third year, the Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam has captivated audiences with over 15 million impressions in previous editions, serving as a launchpad for critically acclaimed titles like Venba and Gourdlets. Whether you're looking for a new favorite game or just want to enjoy the cozy vibes, the Wholesome Games Celebration is the perfect opportunity to discover the joy and creativity that video games have to offer.

[b]ABOUT WHOLESOME GAMES[/b] 
Wholesome Games was founded in 2019 as a curator for artistic, uplifting, and emotionally resonant games. It has since grown into a global platform, including the digital showcase Wholesome Direct, which has reached more than 10 million viewers. In 2023, the team began supporting indie titles like Is This Seat Taken?, Minami Lane, and MakeRoom through the Wholesome Games Presents publishing label. For more information, visit [url="https://www.wholesomegames.com"]www.wholesomegames.com[/url].

📅Dates: August 7-14, 2025 
🕙Start Time: 10am PT / 1pm ET

notes.title: Gcores Publishing Summer Sale Bundle Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]It's summertime! We bring you three of our finest games. Get the best discount of this summer through the bundle now![/p][p][/p][p][b]CATO: Buttered Cat[/b] is an adorable puzzle platformer, inspired by the buttered-cat paradox meme: Cats always land on their feet, and toast always lands buttered side down. notes.notes:
Hello to all the new bug keepers!

Bugtopia is officially out now—thank you all for playing! We've already spotted some in-game issues and released an urgent v1.0.1 patch to address them.

In addition, we've compiled answers to several frequently asked questions. We've also received tons of great suggestions and feedback—thank you! We'll be sharing an update roadmap soon, including upcoming features and content.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect bug descriptions
[*] Fixed missing fonts in certain places
[*] Fixed specific animation errors
[*] Fixed tutorial issues caused by tool purchases
[*] Fixed tutorial issues caused by interaction animations
[*] Fixed an issue where certain special cases in the tutorial could cause the player to get completely stuck
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h3]Can I skip the tutorial?[/h3]
Yes! Press T in-game to skip the tutorial manually. After completing the tutorial once, you can unlock and sell the Guide. (Don't worry—you can always bring it back later by buying a return ticket!)

[h3]Can I carry over my demo save to the full version?[/h3]
Saves are not directly compatible, but you can inherit your demo currency by going to the bottom-right corner of the main menu:
Settings → Function → Load Demo Save Files.
If you unlocked and bought the Spiky Isopod in the demo, you'll also receive an exclusive landscaping item in the full version!

[h3]Why can’t I feed bugs in the pupal stage anymore?[/h3]
To better reflect real-life ecosystems, pupae in the full version no longer eat feed! (It’s a design choice—not a bug~)

[h1]Bug Reports[/h1]

Settings (bottom-right corner or ESC) → Function → Bug
